positioning.$help: Perennial Seller (P1, P2). Write these before any campaign.
positioning.audience: People who would rather say a message than type it: Hindi, Hinglish and Indian-language speakers who write all day on their phone and computer, in WhatsApp, mail, Slack, AI chats and code editors.
positioning.oneSentence: Tailzu is a voice keyboard: talk in Hindi, Hinglish, any of India's 22 scheduled languages or English, and clean, ready-to-send text lands in any app.
positioning.oneParagraph: Tailzu is an AI voice keyboard for iPhone, Android, Windows and Mac. You speak the way you speak, in Hindi, Hinglish, any of India's 22 scheduled languages, English or 23 more languages, and clean, ready-to-send text lands where your cursor is: filler gone, punctuation in, names and numbers kept exactly as you said them. Hinglish stays Hinglish, and it writes in the native script or in English letters. It cleans; it never rewrites. On a computer you tap Ctrl twice, talk, and the text is pasted at the cursor. 800 words a month are free.
positioning.differentFrom: Dictation that types every 'um' and forces one language at a time, and translators that turn your words into someone else's. Tailzu keeps your mix of languages and your exact names and amounts, and only cleans.

oneLiner.$help: StoryBrand one-liner (S9): problem -> solution -> result. Read together it should sound like one natural answer to 'what do you do?'
oneLiner.problem: Typing Hinglish or an Indian language on a keyboard is slow, and plain dictation writes down every 'um'.
oneLiner.solution: Tailzu is a voice keyboard: you talk the way you talk and it writes the message clean, in any app,
oneLiner.result: so you say it badly and send it perfect.

character.who: Someone who writes messages, mails, notes and prompts all day, and thinks and speaks in Hindi, Hinglish or another Indian language
character.want: To get a message out as fast as they can say it, in their own words

problem.villain: The keyboard: small keys, one alphabet, and dictation that types the 'um's
problem.external: Typing Hinglish or an Indian script is slow, and rough speech comes out as rough text
problem.philosophical: Your words should arrive the way you meant them, in the language you actually speak

facts: Voice typing in all 22 scheduled languages of India, Hinglish and English
Voice typing in 23 more languages, including Spanish, Arabic and Japanese
Removes filler words and adds punctuation; keeps names, numbers and amounts exactly
Keeps mixed languages mixed: Hinglish stays Hinglish
Writes in the native script or in English letters
16 voices that set the tone of every message
Works as a keyboard in every app on iPhone and Android
Desktop app for Windows and Mac: tap Ctrl twice, talk, and the text is pasted at the cursor
Lite: unlimited words, USD 9.99 a month; Elite: unlimited words, USD 59.99 a year, 7 days free in the app
Audio is not stored by default; it is deleted once it is written
Needs a connection; it does not work offline
